title: festuca rupicola f. supinoides
intro: Festuca rupicola f. supinoides, commonly known as Alpine Fescue, is a subspecies of the Festuca rupicola plant, which is a type of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is native to mountainous regions in Europe and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Festuca rupicola f. supinoides include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to inhibit platelet aggregation and its potential to lower blood pressure due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids.
